metrics.name: word_recovery_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of 8-bit data words correctly recovered across all read operations in the simulation trace.

metrics.name: structural_match_accuracy
metrics.description: Edit distance between the submitted RTL's abstract syntax tree and the golden RTL's AST, normalized by the golden AST size.

metrics.name: functional_equivalence
metrics.description: Binary pass/fail indicating whether the submission's simulation output matches the reference model cycle-by-cycle for the entire testbench duration.
